uslaw-usc-t2-s143c: Section 143c of Title 2 of the United States Code deals with Library funds moved. The Librarian of Congress may move sums in a fiscal year. The sums are those made free for pay and costs of the Library. They go to the accounts of the United States Capitol Police. The move pays the police back for services at a set event. The event is a special event or program in a linked section. The power stands on top of a like move in that section.
